title: Schedule list appears empty after selecting a site and navigating to the schedule tab
description: After logging into the Luxor Cloud, selecting a specific site, and then clicking on the 'Schedule' tab, the schedule list is displayed as empty, despite having available programs.
steps: Tap the 'GO TO MY SITES' button.
Tap on the site named 'A Wizard'.
actual: The 'Schedule' tab displays an empty list, indicating no available programs, even when programs are expected to be present.
expected: The 'Schedule' tab should display the list of available programs for the selected site.
